Presenting a very special episode of The Slow Cafe with Neelesh Misra
In our latest episode of The Slow Interview with Neelesh Misra, Suresh Raina, the amazing Indian cricket player talks about his struggle, Cricket, mentors, family, children, and life. The Chennai Super Kings star player has achieved so much with his sheer hard work and dedication. His inspiring journey from Meerut, to Lucknow and the world, will leave you awestruck. Sachin once said to him " Believe in yourself" during training and the rest is history.
